intro: Local food and drink news, roadworks to plan around, and an update on the forest’s grazing cattle.

findings.title: The Hair of the Dog
findings.body: A new pub-restaurant has opened on York Hill in Loughton.

findings.title: La Sala
findings.body: Trade press reports a new restaurant, La Sala, has opened in Woodford Green.

findings.title: Zizzi
findings.body: This branch has closed. A separate Zizzi in South Woodford is still open.

findings.title: Morrisons Café
findings.body: The in-store café at the Loughton Morrisons looks to have closed, though the supermarket itself is still trading. Check directly before making a trip.

findings.title: Bakers Lane, Epping
findings.body: Closing for around 16 weeks for resurfacing ahead of the new Epping Leisure Centre. Diversions are signed, and pavements and nearby car parks stay open throughout.

findings.title: Skylark Conservation Event
findings.body: A free conservation event at the Harrow Road Pavilion — no booking required.

grazing.body: The forest's grazing cattle have moved to a new paddock near High Beach, on the eastern side of the forest.
